description:
At Air Products, we reimagine what’s possible. By tapping into the motivation of our people and our collective experience, we create the ideas and innovations that drive us forward. When we come together – where every voice is heard and everyone knows they belong and matter – we create solutions that launch people into space, support lifesaving care in hospitals, and enable the construction of groundbreaking, world scale production facilities.

  

**Reimagine What’s Possible** 

  
  

* Performing the implementation of new and enhanced network technology that aligns to Air Products’ and Project Specific documented standards and strategic direction for enterprise and remote site connectivity.
    
* Learn, understand and comply with Air Products standards for global network infrastructure, including wireless, LAN and SD-WAN networks and connectivity.
    
* Work closely with Enterprise Security and Architects and Network Engineering teams to understand high-level designs and deploy services in line with our strategic direction.
    
* Execute engineering efforts to ensure currency and supportability of networking technology.
    

* Provide network support for problem escalations.
    
* Work with external service providers to troubleshoot and commission wide area network technologies
    
* Participate in Cyber SAT, Integrated SAT and last planner exercises
    
* Meet service level commitments to the business both for network incidents and deployments
    
* Configure and commission ICS network hardware
    

What we’re looking for:

* Bachelor’s degree or related experience required.
    
* Experience with current LAN, WAN and SD WAN networking routing and switching systems.
    
* Applied industry certifications or 5 years equivalent work experience in a network engineering role.
    
* Strong verbal and written communications skills with the ability to articulate detailed technical concepts and effectively communicate with end users at all levels
    
* Physical access to applicable KSA Air Products locations.
    

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
    
* Ability to work effectively in global, cross-organizational teams to assist with projects and tasks.
    
* Meticulous attention to technical details.
    
* Ability to work with strategic vendors, outside service/support providers and other third-party suppliers
    
* Industry skill competence certified professionals
    
* Positive Attitude and result oriented approach
    

Required Skills:

* Strong working knowledge of DNS, DHCP, and IP address management
    
* Extraordinary ability to manage defined scope for field deployments, planning, project management, coordination, and analytical skills.
    
* Ability to recognize and communicate risks and produce mitigation recommendations.
    
* Intermediate skill with network device configuration using CLIs as well as portal/platform management tools.
    
* Intermediate scripting skills in PowerShell, Python and Linux.
    
* Intermediate troubleshooting skills using networking tools such as Wireshark and vendor platform portals to identify and diagnose infrastructure and connectivity issues.
    
* Ability to interpret design diagrams and accurately document basic network infrastructure environments using programs like Visio.
    
* Basic understanding of ITIL process and procedures for lifecycle management.

description:
* Nature of the Work: Hybrid Full Time
* Hours of work: 48 hours per week
* Benefits: Healthcare and Insurance, Employee Stock Purchase program, Flexible Spending Benefit, Flex and Schooling Allowances and many more.
* Application start and end date: Starting July 30th for approx. 4-6 weeks  
    

## **Meet the team**

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a resilient digital world with an end-to-end platform designed for hybrid, multi-cloud environments. We approach our work with kindness, valuing the unique talents, passion, and joy that each team member brings to our collaborative culture. Our team is dedicated to helping organizations reach their best by solving complex business challenges at scale. We foster an environment of inclusiveness, disruption, and fun, ensuring that every member feels supported as they reach new heights.  


## **Your impact**

As a Splunk Cybersecurity Solutions Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the pre-sales process by partnering with our Sales team to deliver technical expertise on advanced security operations solutions. Operating as a senior individual contributor, you will guide enterprise clients in Saudi Arabia through security challenges, mapping their unique needs to integrated security workflows to ensure robust digital resilience.

You will balance technical excellence with a strategic attitude, laying the groundwork to evolve into a leadership capacity while driving our team strategy forward. Success in this role means effectively mentoring peers and designing tailored architectures that empower our rapidly growing customer base to achieve their business objectives securely. Ultimately, you will serve as a trusted domain expert, transforming security obstacles into scalable solutions that protect critical financial and enterprise infrastructures.  


## **What you will do**

* Establish and proactively maintain positive relationships with clients and partners to drive mutual growth in the cybersecurity space.
* Collaborate closely with account teams to align with sales strategies, providing comprehensive support through briefings, proposals, and issue resolution for SecOps portfolios.
* Demonstrate Splunk Cybersecurity products and services onsite, remotely via webinars, and at field events to showcase platform value to prospective buyers.
* Design and architect integrated security workflows tailored to enterprise and financial sector clients to meet their specific regulatory and operational requirements.
* Execute Proof of Values (POVs) and technical integrations to validate solution effectiveness and secure technical wins.
* Apply organized and analytical approaches to creatively overcome sales obstacles and accelerate the sales cycle.
* Mentor junior team members by sharing domain expertise and driving team strategy to prepare for future leadership responsibilities.  
    

## **Minimum qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales, or solution architecture within the cybersecurity sector.
* Experience designing and implementing integrated security workflows within Security Operations (SecOps) environments.
* Experience configuring and deploying enterprise cybersecurity platforms, such as Palo Alto Networks (CORTEX), Chronicle, Microsoft Defender, or Fortinet.
* Experience conducting Proof of Value (POV) engagements and delivering technical product demonstrations for enterprise security solutions.
* Experience working directly with enterprises in Saudi Arabia.  
    

## **Preferred qualifications**

* Attainment of industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, SANS Cybersecurity, or vendor-specific credentials (e.g., Palo Alto, Microsoft).
* Experience mentoring technical teams and leading strategic pre-sales initiatives.
* Experience working with modern application architectures, including Kubernetes, Docker, or serverless technologies.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages, such as Python, Java, or Go.
* Knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and concepts, including LLMs or GenAI frameworks, as they apply to security analytics.
* Understanding of digital resilience strategies and how security solutions integrate to support overall business continuity.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively translate complex technical concepts to diverse business and technical audiences.

# Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

  

Cisconians power the future. We make impact as a team, innovating fast and fearlessly to create meaningful solutions on a large scale. The depth and breadth of our technology doesn't just benefit our customers – it also means limitless opportunities for us to experiment and learn. We understand the power each of our unique backgrounds bring when we work together. Because of that, we have a global network of thinkers, doers, experts, and curious creators who help one another do their life’s best work.

job_title: Building Management System Engineer (BMS)- Riyadh, KSA
description:
A specialized engineering professional responsible for designing, programming, and commissioning automated building management systems with a strong emphasis on the Niagara N4 framework. They integrate critical low-current and IoT subsystems—such as HVAC, lighting, fire alarms, and access control—using industry-standard protocols like BACnet and Modbus. By developing user-friendly graphic dashboards and automation sequences, they optimize building energy efficiency, system performance, and operational reliability. Additionally, they manage field hardware deployment, ensure cybersecurity compliance, and collaborate closely with MEP teams and subcontractors throughout project lifecycles.

* Design and develop BMS architecture based on project requirements.
* Install and configure BMS hardware and software (controllers, sensors, actuators).
* Program control logic and automation sequences for HVAC, lighting, and other subsystems.
* Test and commission BMS systems to ensure functionality and performance.
* Monitor and optimize energy consumption using BMS analytics.
* Integrate third-party systems (e.g., fire alarm, access control, elevators) via Modbus, BACnet, or SNMP.
* Troubleshoot and resolve faults in BMS systems and connected field devices.
* Conduct site surveys and system inspections for retrofit or upgrade projects.
* Maintain and update BMS graphics interfaces for real-time monitoring.
* Collaborate with MEP, HVAC, and electrical teams during project execution.
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on BMS hardware and software.
* Support remote monitoring and system diagnostics using IoT platforms.
* Generate reports on energy performance, fault logs, and system alarms.
* Provide technical support and training to operators and end-users.
* Select suitable sensors, actuators, and controllers for specific applications.
* Verify compliance with standards such as ASHRAE, ISO, and local codes.
* Ensure cybersecurity best practices in BMS networks and remote access points.
* Manage subcontractors and vendors during BMS installation and commissioning.
* Document system schematics, as-built drawings, and O&M manuals.
* Continuously evaluate system performance and suggest improvements for efficiency and reliability.
* Develop and deploy control strategies using Niagara N4 framework for HVAC, lighting, and energy systems.
* Create custom dashboards, alarms, and trend logs within Niagara N4 for real-time system monitoring and analytics.

**Requirements**

* Familiarity with BMS, ELC, ICT, IOT and other low current systems.
* Experience: 1-3 years using Niagara N4 framework.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science or Mechatronics Engineering
* Computer Literate, AutoCAD, Advance in Excel and other Office tools.
* Excellent in English Language.
* High-Level communication skills.
* Ability to create big-picture software solutions.
* Ability to present ideas in a clean, user-friendly way.
* Attention to detail.
reason: The job primarily focuses on designing, programming, and managing building management systems, which is more aligned with industrial control and automation rather than the defined technical specializations.

description:
The Application Architect is responsible for defining, assessing, and evolving the enterprise application architecture to ensure that the application landscape supports business capabilities, digital transformation priorities, integration needs, security requirements, and enterprise architecture standards. The role focuses on current-state application assessment, target-state design, application portfolio optimization, modernization, rationalization, interoperability, and alignment with enterprise technology direction.

**Requirements**

· Develop and maintain the enterprise application architecture in alignment with business strategy and enterprise architecture direction.

· Assess the current application landscape, including business applications, platforms, interfaces, dependencies, lifecycle status, and functional coverage.

· Define target-state application architecture and transition roadmaps supporting business and digital transformation initiatives.

· Map applications to business capabilities, business services, processes, data domains, and technology platforms.

· Identify duplication, functional overlap, application gaps, technical debt, and rationalization opportunities across the application portfolio.

· Support application modernization, replacement, consolidation, retirement, and cloud migration initiatives.

· Define application architecture principles, standards, patterns, and reference architectures.

· Design application interaction models, application cooperation views, dependency maps, and integration touchpoints.

· Collaborate with solution, integration, data, cloud, infrastructure, and security architects to ensure coherent end-to-end architectures.

· Assess commercial-off-the-shelf, SaaS, custom-developed, and platform-based solutions from an architecture perspective.

· Evaluate application scalability, maintainability, interoperability, resilience, security, and alignment with enterprise standards.

· Support Application Portfolio Management and technology lifecycle management activities.

· Provide architecture guidance for APIs, microservices, modular applications, event-driven solutions, and modern application platforms.

· Participate in architecture governance, design reviews, and Architecture Review Boards.

· Support RFP development, vendor evaluation, technical assessments, and application selection processes.

· Identify application architecture risks, dependencies, constraints, and remediation actions.

description:
Every day, ANDRITZ continues to deliver successful innovative solutions to our customers globally. Why are we so successful? Because we are passionate and love what we do! We are at the forefront of future engineering technologies, with solutions that ensure the success of our clients in key industries that are shaping the future of the world we live in.

ANDRITZ has an immediate opportunity for a skilled Instrumentation and Control Systems Engineer to support the design, specification, implementation, commissioning, and troubleshooting of industrial instrumentation and control systems. In this role, you will work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams to design and implement robust, reliable, and maintainable instrumentation and control systems for complex industrial applications.

You will play a key role in instrumentation engineering, PLC/DCS programming and integration, supporting procurement and vendor activities, and providing commissioning and start-up support, while ensuring alignment with technical standards, safety requirements, and customer expectations. This position is ideal for an engineer who combines strong system-level expertise with hands-on experience and thrives in dynamic project environments.

What You Will Be Doing

Here’s an overview of your responsibilities and how you can leverage your expertise:

• Perform site assessments and evaluate existing instrumentation and control systems to define scope, risks, and technical approach

• Specify and select field instrumentation including flow, pressure, temperature, level, density, and analytical measurement devices.

• Develop control system designs, including system architecture, control philosophies, and functional specifications (PLC/DCS/SCADA)

• Design, configure, and support PLC, DCS, and HMI/SCADA systems, including control logic, interlocks, and alarm management strategies

• Prepare and maintain engineering deliverables such as instrument datasheets, material requisitions, control narratives, I/O lists, control system architecture diagrams, and functional design specifications

• Coordinate control system integration, including I/O assignments, communications, and interfaces with third-party systems

• Support procurement activities by reviewing vendor packages, technical submittals, and FAT documentation

• Collaborate with process, electrical, mechanical, and construction teams to ensure alignment between control strategies and system design

• Provide field support during construction, commissioning, and start-up, including instrument calibration, system checkout, loop verification, troubleshooting, and performance validation

• Develop and execute commissioning and acceptance documentation, including FAT/SAT procedures and system turnover documentation

• Ensure control systems are implemented and commissioned in accordance with project requirements, standards, and best practices

• Troubleshoot field instrumentation issues and recommend corrective actions.

• Adhere to company safety standards, including the ANDRITZ Life-Saving Rules, and promote a strong safety culture

• Demonstrate and reinforce #1ANDRITZway core values and behaviors in all aspects of work

What We’re Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Automation, or Controls Engineering (or related discipline)

• Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in instrumentation and control systems engineering within industrial environments

• Strong experience with PLC, DCS, and/or SCADA systems, including configuration, programming, and system integration

• Experience specifying and developing instrumentation and control system deliverables such as data sheets, functional design specifications, control narratives, and I/O lists

• Proven experience supporting installation, commissioning and start-up of instrumentation and control systems.

• Solid understanding of industrial control system architecture, communications, and interfaces

• Experience with instrument calibration and troubleshooting

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within project teams

• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support site activities

• Fluency in English is required; Arabic language skills are a strong asset

Nice to Have

• Experience in mining, mineral processing, or other heavy industrial environments

• Hands-on experience with major control platforms (e.g., Yokogawa, Siemens, Rockwell/Allen-Bradley, ABB, Emerson, Honeywell)

• Experience participating in FAT/SAT and commissioning of instrumentation and control systems

• Understanding of industrial networks and communication protocols (e.g., OPC, Modbus, Ethernet/IP, Profibus)

• Knowledge of functional safety concepts (e.g., SIL / IEC 61511)

• Exposure to advanced control strategies or optimization systems is an asset

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

Position Overview

Supports daily SOC operations by monitoring CCTV, access control, alarm, and communication systems; receiving emergency and non-emergency calls; assessing incidents; and coordinating appropriate response actions. The role ensures timely escalation, accurate incident documentation, effective communication with field personnel and stakeholders, and compliance with established SOC procedures to support a safe and secure operating environment.

Key Responsibilities

 

·       Report directly to the SOC Security Specialist and perform assigned operational duties in accordance with established SOC procedures at AMP-2.

·       Monitor CCTV, access control, alarm systems, and other security platforms to maintain continuous situational awareness and escalate abnormal conditions promptly.

·       Receive, assess, document, and communicate emergency and non-emergency information in accordance with established escalation procedures.

·       Maintain accurate incident logs, activity records, emergency documentation, and operational reports.

·       Prepare incident reports, shift handover reports, and supporting documentation for management review.

·       Coordinate communications with field security personnel, internal departments, emergency responders, and external stakeholders during routine and emergency situations affecting AMP-2 operations.

·       Monitor the operational status of CCTV, access control, communication systems, radios, emergency backup equipment, and other security technologies at AMP-2, and report malfunctions immediately.

·       Maintain emergency contact lists, operational records, and emergency management documentation to support business continuity for AMP-2 operations.

·       Collect, verify, and relay operational information to support incident response and emergency coordination within AMP-2.

·       Support emergency response activities by maintaining effective communication and providing timely operational updates.

·       Respond to requests from field personnel and internal stakeholders in a professional and timely manner.

·       Follow established emergency response plans, crisis management procedures, and SOC Standard Operating Procedures applicable to AMP-2.

·       Identify, document, and report security incidents, operational issues, equipment failures, and security vulnerabilities in a timely manner.

·       Maintain the confidentiality of security information, investigations, and operational activities.

·       Demonstrate professionalism, teamwork, accountability, and effective communication while contributing to SOC operational objectives.

·       Perform other operational duties as assigned by the SOC Specialist or SOC Management.

Skills

·      Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and professionally to different levels of personnel.

·      Reliable, punctual, and dependable in supporting shift-based SOC operations.

·      Knowledge of emergency communication technologies, CCTV monitoring, access control, alarm systems, and SOC best practices within a manufacturing environment.

·      Ability to remain calm, professional, and effective under pressure.

·      Ability to prepare accurate reports, incident logs, and operational documentation.

·      Ability to work collaboratively with security teams, internal departments, and external response agencies.

·      High level of integrity and confidentiality when handling sensitive security information and operational matters.

·      Ability to follow instructions, procedures, and escalation protocols accurately.

·      Proficient computer skills, including data entry, electronic reporting, and operation of SOC-related systems.

Minimum Qualifications

 

·      Associate degree with 6+ years of relevant experience.

description:
Lead Qiddiya’s fixed-site general security operating model, with clear accountability for static guarding, security posts, access control, staffing for dynamic & fixed-location pedestrian and baggage screening, asset protection, and contracted guard-force performance. The role owns fixed-location security delivery and does not own patrol tasking, rapid response, alarm response or security escorts, which are owned by the Senior Manager, Mobile Security & Patrols.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Direct and assure fixed-site security operations across assigned assets, critical infrastructure and public-realm locations, including static guarding, security-post coverage, access control, pedestrian and baggage screening, visitor/personnel access control, protection of critical assets and infrastructure, and public-facing security services.

• Convert approved security requirements, MOSP controls, risk assessments and asset security plans into site-specific standard operating procedures, post orders, deployment plans, staffing requirements, supervisory arrangements, daily tasking and auditable operational records.

• Lead General Security employees and contracted personnel, establishing clear reporting lines, shift-level supervision and performance expectations, and holding responsible managers and service providers accountable for staffing compliance, licensing, competence, conduct, welfare, attendance and service quality.

• Develop, implement and maintain site-specific procedures for static posts, foot patrols, fixed access points, visitor and contractor processing (access management implementation), credential verification, pedestrian and baggage screening, searches, prohibited-item handling and restricted-area access under City Security responsibility.

• Establish, approve, issue and periodically review post orders, access-control procedures, local emergency actions, incident logs, handover records and other fixed-site operational documentation, ensuring current versions are relevant to the operation and audit ready.

• Monitor contracted guarding providers against approved staffing levels, licenses, rosters, shift patterns, supervisory coverage, uniform and equipment standards, welfare requirements and agreed KPIs; document deficiencies, assign corrective actions and escalate repeated or material non-compliance.

• Review and control proposed changes to security posts, shift arrangements, staffing levels, operating hours and contracted service scope, ensuring that operational, risk, welfare, commercial and approval impacts are assessed and formally authorized before implementation.

• Plan and conduct documented field inspections of security posts, access-control points, screening operations and critical-infrastructure protection measures; record non-conformances, assign owners and deadlines, escalate overdue or high-risk findings and verify evidence of corrective-action closure.

• Lead fixed-site security readiness for new city asset openings and operational transitions, confirming approved post locations, staffing and supervision, access and screening arrangements, welfare facilities, communications, equipment, standard operating procedures, emergency response plans, training, rehearsals and mobilization acceptance before go-live.

• Direct the fixed-site operational response and follow-up for access breaches, screening failures, losses and asset-protection incidents, ensuring immediate controls, preservation of evidence, timely reporting and escalation, investigation support, corrective-action tracking and coordinated closure with DSOC and relevant stakeholders.

• Maintain documented tasking, escalation and handover arrangements with Mobile Security & Patrols for reinforcement, patrol support, alarm response, security escorts and incident response, while retaining General Security accountability for fixed-site command, access control and site-level continuity.

• Provide security operational input during stage-gate briefings, identifying fixed-site security requirements, dependencies, risks and readiness actions to support informed decisions and ensure asset operational readiness before handover / opening.

**Requirements**

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent recognised qualification in security, risk, operations, business or a related discipline.

Professional Certifications - CPP, CSMP, PSP or equivalent desirable.

Incident command, contract management or health and safety qualifications are desirable.

10+ years in security operations, including substantial management responsibility.

Proven leadership of static guarding, access control, fixed-post operations and asset protection across multiple locations.

Experience managing contracted guard forces, staffing compliance, KPIs, non-conformance and service recovery.

Experience supporting asset openings, public-facing operations and elevated security requirements in a complex environment.

Saudi Arabia, GCC, major destination, critical infrastructure or giga-project experience is advantageous.

description:
About EnerVenue
EnerVenue is a Silicon Valley-based energy infrastructure company commercializing metal-hydrogen battery technology originally developed by NASA for the Hubble Space Telescope and the International Space Station. Founded in 2020 by Stanford Professor Yi Cui, EnerVenue adapts this proven aerospace chemistry for grid-scale terrestrial energy storage, delivering batteries with 30,000+ cycle lifetimes, inherent fire-safety, and a 30-year design life.
In 2026, EnerVenue closed a $300 million Series B extension and is well capitalized for growth. Funds are being deployed to build a high-volume manufacturing facility in Changzhou, China, targeting 250 MWh capacity by Q3 2026 and 1 GWh by 2027. EnerVenue has been named one of Time magazine's Top 10 US Green Technology Companies of 2025.

The Role
We are seeking a technically rigorous and customer-focused Energy Storage Applications Engineer to bridge the gap between our advanced energy storage technology and real-world deployment. This is a strategic, hands-on role critical to our mission. You will translate customer requirements into optimized system designs, validate performance across diverse use cases, and ensure our solutions deliver measurable value in the field. Acting as the technical backbone of the commercial process, you will support sales, marketing, product, and engineering teams with modeling, integration guidance, technical sales support, and application expertise.
This role covers EnerVenue's Middle East region and is based remotely in Saudi Arabia, working directly with utilities, developers, EPC contractors and industrial customers across the Kingdom and the wider GCC.

Key Responsibilities
Lead the Technical Pre-Sales Process:
Serve as the primary technical partner to Sales throughout the commercial lifecycle—from initial qualification through contract execution. Shape deal strategy by translating customer use cases, financial objectives, and operating constraints into technically optimized, commercially compelling storage solutions.

Translate Market Opportunities into Bankable Proposals:
· Lead technical discovery sessions to define duty cycles, performance guarantees, augmentation strategies, and integration requirements.
· Develop robust energy storage models that quantify lifetime performance, degradation, efficiency, availability, and ROI.
· Produce detailed technical proposals and bid packages, including system sizing, single-line diagrams, performance assumptions, and compliance documentation.

Strengthen Technical Sales Enablement:
· Partner with Sales to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and technical due diligence requests with speed, accuracy, and credibility.
· Support customer meetings, executive presentations, and contract negotiations as the technical authority.
· Develop standardized tools, calculators, and modeling frameworks that improve proposal consistency, cycle time, and win rates.
· Manage customer facing technical documentation and work alongside technical teams to generate documentation as necessary for project proposals.
· Develop and/or review System designs, Single Lines, Layouts, Containerization, Performance guarantees, Availability guarantees, etc.

Amplify Marketing & Market Positioning:
· Collaborate with Marketing to develop application notes, white papers, case studies, and technical content that articulate differentiated value.
· Translate complex engineering advantages into clear, benefit-driven messaging for target segments (utility-scale, C&I, microgrid).
· Provide technical input for product launches, webinars, conference presentations, and thought leadership initiatives.

Accelerate Cross-Functional Alignment:
· Serve as a bridge from the Commercial team to Product and Engineering, ensuring customer requirements and emerging use cases inform the roadmap.
· Support commissioning readiness and early deployment to protect performance assumptions made during the sales process.

Position Requirements:
The ideal candidate likely spent the first part of his or her career building deep technical foundations in power systems, battery engineering, PV + storage integration, or grid-connected infrastructure—either at a leading OEM, EPC, developer, utility, or technology-driven energy company—where he or she developed rigorous analytical skills and a strong safety mindset. He or she has since operated in a fast-paced, customer-facing or scaling environment, applying that technical depth to commercial pursuits and supporting projects from early-stage feasibility through commissioning and field optimization.

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Energy Systems, or a related technical discipline.
· 5+ years of progressive experience in Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), including system design, applications engineering, integration, technical sales support, and service.
· Demonstrated expertise designing multi-MW scale energy storage systems, with strong command of both DC and AC electrical design principles.
· High level of technical aptitude spanning from battery cell fundamentals through C&I and utility-scale battery systems.
· Strong working knowledge of secondary battery chemistries, degradation mechanisms, system architectures, and operational limitations across diverse duty cycles.
· Practical experience with balance-of-system (BOS) equipment, including inverters, medium-voltage transformers, combiner boxes, DC/DC converters, EMS, and BMS platforms.
· Strong knowledge of NEC and applicable regulatory codes and standards for PV and energy storage installations, including NFPA 70 (NEC), IEEE 1547, UL 9540, UL 1741, and other relevant global standards.
· Working knowledge of grid connection and product compliance requirements applicable in Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, including Saudi Electricity Company grid connection requirements and SASO / GSO conformity schemes.
· Solid understanding of how energy storage and PV projects are constructed, commissioned, and brought online.
· Experience specifying or validating energy storage equipment for high-ambient-temperature environments.
· Ability to interpret operational data, apply statistical analysis techniques, and produce clear, actionable reports.
· Working knowledge of commercial contracts, performance guarantees, and how technical design and proposal assumptions must support contractual obligations.
· Familiarity with competitive energy storage products in the market and the ability to clearly articulate differentiated technical value.
· Proven ability to operate cross-functionally across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and field teams.
· Demonstrated ability to meet tight deadlines, manage multiple priorities, and maintain accountability for deliverables.
· Professional fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken, with the ability to run technical discussions and present to customers in both languages.
· Based in Saudi Arabia and working remotely, with the right to work in the Kingdom.
· Willingness and ability to travel 10–20% to support customer engagement, project development, site validation, and industry events.

Mandatory Core Competencies
• Technical Depth & Range:
You are equally comfortable discussing electrochemical behavior at the cell level and reviewing single-line diagrams for multi-MW grid-connected systems. You can move seamlessly between modeling software and a job site.
• Pre-Sales & Commercial Orientation:
You understand that technical precision underpins revenue. Your expertise turns technical jargon into marketing differentiation. You support proposals that stand up to RFP scrutiny, independent engineer review, and contractual performance guarantees.
• Professional & Accountable:
You meet commitments, communicate proactively, and maintain composure and clarity under tight timelines and high-stakes customer interactions.

Ideal Mindset & Competencies
• Bridge Builder (Between Engineering and Revenue):
They see themselves as a strategic enabler of growth. Their technical clarity accelerates deal cycles, increases win rates, and strengthens customer confidence.
• Application-First Thinker:
They design around real operating profiles—capacity firming, arbitrage, peak shaving, resilience, grid services—ensuring systems are optimized for performance and economics. They are also a code master, ensuring all stakeholders are aligned with NEC, IEEE, UL, and applicable global standards.
• Commercially Fluent Engineer:
They understand contracts, guarantees, liquidated damages risk, and bankability requirements—and ensure technical proposals align with those realities.
• Market-Aware Technologist:
They track competitor capabilities and industry standards closely, positioning EnerVenue’s technology with precision and credibility.
• Disciplined Under Pressure:
They thrive under deadlines, balancing technical thoroughness with commercial urgency, and consistently deliver high-quality work on schedule.
• Forward-Thinking & Creative:
They anticipate evolving grid needs, emerging use cases, and new commercial models—bringing fresh thinking to how energy storage is designed, positioned, and deployed.

What EnerVenue Offers

• Unique opportunity to own full end-to-end technical application engineering work of a disruptive long-duration metal-hydrogen energy storage technology in the Middle East, the company’s key strategic growth market

• Direct alignment with EnerVenue’s manufacturing team and joint technical roadmap planning with product engineering team

• Competitive compensation package for mid-level technical leadership role including base salary and project performance bonus tied to successful bid delivery and project win rate

• Mid-level technical management position backed by top-tier global investors, with clear gigawatt-scale production capacity expansion roadmap based out of Changzhou, China to fully support Middle East market supply

• Join a mission-driven team developing 30-year service-life grid infrastructure energy storage equipment

• Full technical training resources, access to global electrochemical R&D data and field test cases, plus funding for regional industry conferences and standard certification upgrades

description:
### Job Summary

The Road Network Engineer is responsible for the planning, design, operation, and maintenance assessment of road networks within urban developments, communities, cities, and large-scale infrastructure projects. The role focuses on enhancing connectivity, traffic flow, road safety, and transportation efficiency through engineering analysis, design reviews, and performance monitoring.

### Key Responsibilities

### Road Network Planning & Design

* Develop road network strategies and transportation infrastructure plans.
* Review and evaluate road layouts, alignments, intersections, and access points.
* Ensure road designs comply with local and international engineering standards.
* Assess road hierarchy, connectivity, and capacity requirements for current and future demand.
* Support master planning activities and infrastructure integration.

### Traffic Engineering & Analysis

* Conduct traffic studies, transportation assessments, and capacity analyses.
* Analyze traffic volumes, flow patterns, congestion points, and network performance.
* Identify bottlenecks and recommend infrastructure improvements.
* Support transportation demand management initiatives.
* Evaluate road network performance using simulation and modeling tools.

### Road Safety & Compliance

* Conduct road safety audits and inspections.
* Identify safety risks, accident-prone locations, and operational deficiencies.
* Recommend measures to improve road safety, signage, pavement markings, and traffic control systems.
* Ensure compliance with municipal, transportation authority, and regulatory requirements.

### Infrastructure Performance Monitoring

* Monitor road network performance through data collection and analysis.
* Evaluate pavement conditions, road asset functionality, and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams to prioritize repairs and upgrades.
* Develop performance reports and recommendations for continuous improvement.

### Smart Mobility & Transportation Systems

* Support implementation of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).
* Evaluate traffic management technologies and smart mobility solutions.
* Coordinate integration of road infrastructure with public transportation, cycling, and pedestrian networks.
* Support initiatives related to sustainable transportation and future mobility.

### Stakeholder Coordination

* Coordinate with government authorities, consultants, contractors, and utility providers.
* Review engineering submissions, technical reports, and design packages.
* Participate in project meetings and provide technical guidance.
* Support project delivery from planning through construction and operation phases.

### Reporting & Documentation

* Prepare technical reports, traffic assessments, and engineering recommendations.
* Maintain records of road network studies, inspections, and improvement initiatives.
* Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders.

### Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering, or a related field.
* Master's degree in Transportation Engineering is an advantage.
* Professional Engineer (PE) registration or equivalent certification is preferred.

### Experience

* 4-8 years of experience in road design, transportation planning, traffic engineering, or highway infrastructure projects.
* Experience with urban developments, smart cities, transportation networks, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
* Experience working with government authorities, municipalities, or engineering consultancies is preferred.

description:
Who we are

Elia Grid International (EGI) is a global power systems consultancy supporting the transformation of electricity systems worldwide. Built on the expertise of leading European transmission system operators—Elia (Belgium) and 50Hertz (Germany)—EGI delivers high-level technical and strategic advisory services to power utilities, regulators, and energy stakeholders.

With offices in Belgium, Germany, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Malaysia, and Canada, you will join an international, collaborative, and fast-growing environment, where learning and impact go hand in hand.

  

In Saudi Arabia, EGI contributes to projects that support Vision 2030, including renewable energy integration, grid expansion, system reliability, and advanced transmission solutions.

  

Your role

As a Junior Power System Engineer, you will be part of experienced project teams and progressively take responsibility on real-life power system studies. You will learn how transmission systems are planned, analysed, and optimised to support the energy transition.

  

Typical activities include (with training and support):

· Supporting the development of power system consultancy services in kSA

· Performing Data collection

· Building, updating, and validating power system models

· Contributing to studies related to renewable energy and battery storage integration

· Performing power system simulations (load flow, short circuit, hosting capacity, transient stability,..etc.)

· Preparing clear and structured technical reports and presentations

· Gradually participating in client interactions and proposal preparation alongside senior experts

Your responsibilities will evolve based on your skills, interests, and development path, with close guidance from experienced power system specialists.

  

Your profile

We are looking for motivated graduates or junior engineers who are eager to learn and grow:

· Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or similar

· 0–3 years of experience (freshly graduates are welcome to apply)

· Basic knowledge of power systems and transmission networks

· First exposure to power system tools such as PowerFactory or PSS®E is a plus

· Curious, proactive, and willing to develop technical and consulting skills

· Comfortable working in a team and in an international environment

· Good communication skills in English (Arabic is a strong asset)

  

What we offer

· Permanent contract with a competitive salary package

· Structured on-the-job training, mentoring, and technical coaching

· Exposure to international projects and cutting-edge energy challenges

· A clear career development path in a fast-growing consultancy

· A collaborative and inclusive work culture where young talent is supported and valued

  

Diversity & inclusion

At EGI, we believe diverse teams drive better solutions. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to learn, grow, and succeed—regardless of gender, background, or nationality.

  

Why join EGI?

At EGI, you will:

· Work on projects that directly contribute to Saudi Vision 2030

· Develop strong technical skills in power system planning

· Gain exposure to international experts and global projects

· Build a solid and sustainable career in the energy sector

  

You will not only build strong technical expertise, but also develop a consulting mindset that combines engineering excellence with real-world impact.

  

Location

Riyadh Mobility: around 10% worldwide, depending on project needs

  

Want to know more about us?

[We let your future colleagues do the talking](https://vimeo.com/1193231446?share=copy&fl=sv&fe=ci)

Check our [website](https://eliagrid-int.com/) and our [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/elia-grid-international/) page for last news and updates.

description:
Job Description

Systems Engineer – Oil & Gas

Location – Dammam/AlKhobar Eastern Province (Saudi Arabia)

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to work closely with a sales representative in Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. The Systems Engineer's main mission will be to support the sales organization in all technical matters regarding pre-sales, sales calls, and post-sales.

With us you will

Lead all technical aspects of a sales cycle with the Enterprise customers, from the initial RFIs, through to RFPs & RFQs when required. This includes the project management and active participation in POCs in partnership with the relevant teams both internally and within the customer and/or commercial partner.

Have the ability to listen and to understand the technical requirements of the customer, reading between the lines to build a solution which outperforms the competitor offering.

Be the primary technical point of contact for the customer(s) and partners in close collaboration with your sales partner.

Continuously strive to improve knowledge around the Fortinet products and solutions, along with maintaining a deep understanding of the competitive landscape and Fortinet’s ability to provide long lasting protection against the ever-evolving threats.

Have a strong ability to position Fortinet solutions to the customer, whether this be remotely or in person. This requires strong communication skills and the ability to confidently present through whiteboarding, technical white papers, technical plans or customer discussions.

Manage your time effectively when working on multiple deals simultaneously, ensuring a positive customer experience is maintained.

Maintain accurate activity, contact, and account technical information of all customers and prospects in our CRM (Salesforce).

Apply if you

Have a high aptitude for security technology, specifically encryption, authentication, with further knowledge of network security, intrusion detection, anti-virus, routing, switching, LAN and WAN being desirable. The CISSP accreditation would also be beneficial.

Are currently or have previously worked in a pre-sales engineer role, managing end to end technical aspects of deals, through to technical closure.

Can demonstrate your problem solving skills and how this has impacted key wins within your current organisation.

Understand and can demonstrate your ability to build and maintain customer relationships, including your ability to effectively communicate technically to a range of both external and internal stakeholders.

Have a strong understanding of RADIUS, PKI, IKE, Certificates, L2TP, IPSEC, FIREWALL, 802.1Q, MD5, SSH, SSL, SHA1, DES, 3DES

What you can expect from us

Excellent training and development opportunities, providing you with all the tools you need to be successful.

An open working environment, sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to everyone’s thoughts and opinions.

The opportunity to be part of an innovative, collaborative and winning team.

A competitive salary and incentive compensation package, including stock awards, health and welfare benefits.

From the start, the Fortinet vision has been to deliver broad, truly integrated, high-performance security across the IT infrastructure. Today, we secure the largest enterprises, service providers and government organizations around the world.

Fortinet empowers its customers with intelligent, seamless protection across the expanding attack surface and the power to take on ever-increasing performance requirements of the borderless network – today and into the future. We have proven to be a truly innovative technology driven network security company with over 619 registered Global Patents. This is over 3 times more than our closest most innovative competitor!

Why Join Us:

At Fortinet, we embrace diversity and inclusivity. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and identities. Explore our welcoming work environment designed for a rewarding career journey with an attractive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well-being. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

We will only notify shortlisted candidates.

Fortinet will not entertain any unsolicited resumes, please refrain from sending them to any Fortinet employees or Fortinet email aliases. Should any Agency submit any resumes to Fortinet, these resumes if considered, will be assumed to have been given by the Agency free of any related fees/charges.

job_title: Road Network Engineer (ITS) - City Operations & Maintenance (Saudi National)
description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Road Network Engineer (ITS) – City Operations & Maintenance (Saudi National)** to join our team! In this role you will get to oversee the operational performance, safety, asset condition, and continuous traffic flow of a city-wide road network within a landmark giga-project. You will support Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic operations, road asset maintenance, event mobility, and smart-city integration to ensure highways, urban streets, and transit corridors operate safely and efficiently during daily operations and major events.  


## What You'll Be Doing

* Oversee the day-to-day operational performance and condition of highways, urban roads, intersections, transit corridors, and associated road infrastructure.
    
* Monitor real-time traffic conditions using Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), traffic management platforms, roadside sensors, CCTV, and traffic data feeds.
    
* Analyze traffic speeds, volumes, congestion levels, travel times, incidents, and network performance to identify operational issues.
    
* Monitor and optimize intelligent traffic signal operations and timing plans to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion.
    
* Coordinate with Traffic Management Centers (TMC), City Operations, Security, emergency services, and other stakeholders during incidents and network disruptions.
    
* Support rapid response to road accidents, vehicle breakdowns, obstructions, and other incidents affecting network availability.
    
* Develop and implement traffic management measures to maintain safe and efficient movement during planned and unplanned disruptions.
    
* Conduct regular technical inspections and condition assessments of roads, pavements, intersections, and associated infrastructure.
    
* Identify pavement defects including cracking, potholes, rutting, settlement, surface deterioration, and other asset condition issues.
    
* Develop and coordinate preventive and corrective road maintenance programs based on asset condition, operational priority, and lifecycle requirements.
    
* Support planning and delivery of pavement rehabilitation, resurfacing, road marking, and associated maintenance activities.
    
* Monitor the condition and maintenance of road barriers, guardrails, street lighting, stormwater drainage, road markings, signage, and associated roadside assets.
    
* Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize disruption to traffic and maintain safe access throughout the network.
    
* Monitor contractors performing road, ITS, and associated infrastructure maintenance and verify compliance with approved SLAs, KPIs, specifications, and safety requirements.
    
* Develop and review Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans for construction activities, maintenance works, concerts, sporting events, festivals, and other major events.
    
* Plan safe diversions, detours, temporary lane closures, traffic control arrangements, and alternative access routes.
    
* Coordinate event traffic strategies with parking, public transport, security, emergency response, venue operations, and mobility teams.
    
* Assess road network capacity against anticipated event demand and identify potential congestion points before major events.
    
* Coordinate road network operations with parking arrival and departure strategies to reduce queuing and congestion around major destinations.
    
* Analyze historical and real-time traffic telemetry to identify recurring congestion zones, network bottlenecks, and operational improvement opportunities.
    
* Support integration of roadside ITS devices, traffic signals, CCTV, Variable Message Signs (VMS), traffic detectors, and other smart mobility technologies.
    
* Coordinate integration of road and ITS systems with the central City Operations or Traffic Management platform.
    
* Support planning and operational readiness for connected, autonomous, and emerging mobility technologies where applicable.
    
* Develop and monitor network performance indicators covering traffic flow, congestion, incidents, asset condition, system availability, and maintenance performance.
    
* Maintain accurate road asset records, inspection findings, maintenance histories, incident logs, and operational data using GIS, CMMS, or asset management systems.
    
* Prepare technical reports, traffic assessments, dashboards, maintenance recommendations, and management presentations.
    
* Identify operational and asset-related risks and develop practical mitigation and improvement measures.
    
* Coordinate with Asset Management, Parking Operations, Public Transport, Facilities Management, ICT, Security, HSE, contractors, consultants, and technology vendors.
    
* Support emergency response, incident management, business continuity, and road network recovery activities.
    
* Promote road safety, asset reliability, smart mobility, and continuous improvement across City Operations.
    
* Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as appropriate.
    

## What Required Skills You'll Bring

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering, Highway Engineering, Traffic Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
    
* Minimum **5+ years of experience** in road maintenance, highway engineering, traffic operations, ITS, transportation engineering, or related infrastructure operations.
    
* Minimum **2+ years of experience supporting giga-projects, major municipalities, smart cities, major destinations, or similarly complex urban environments.**
    
* Active membership/registration with the **Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE)**.
    
* Strong technical knowledge of road network operations, highway engineering, traffic management, and road asset maintenance.
    
* Strong understanding of **Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS)** and their application to real-time traffic operations.
    
* Experience with:
    
* Traffic Management Systems
    
* Traffic signal control systems
    
* CCTV and incident detection
    
* Variable Message Signs (VMS)
    
* Traffic detectors and roadside sensors
    
* Traffic data and telemetry
    
* Smart traffic control technologies
    
* Strong understanding of traffic flow, road capacity, congestion management, intersection operations, and network performance.
    
* Experience developing or reviewing Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) plans, diversions, detours, and lane closure arrangements.
    
* Experience supporting major event traffic and transportation operations.
    
* Strong knowledge of road and pavement inspection, maintenance, rehabilitation, and lifecycle management.
    
* Knowledge of associated road assets including barriers, signage, road markings, drainage, and street lighting.
    
* Strong knowledge of relevant international highway and transportation standards, including **AASHTO**, and applicable Saudi transportation requirements and standards.
    
* Experience using traffic simulation and modelling software such as **VISSIM or equivalent**.
    
* Familiarity with GIS platforms, CMMS, road asset management systems, and digital reporting tools.
    
* Ability to analyze traffic and asset performance data and translate findings into practical operational recommendations.
    
* Strong understanding of road safety, traffic incident management, and emergency response requirements.
    
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
    
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
    
* Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, authorities, emergency services, contractors, consultants, technology providers, and multidisciplinary operational teams.
    

## What Desired Skills You'll Bring

* Experience supporting road and ITS operations within **Saudi Arabian giga-projects, smart cities, major municipalities, airports, entertainment destinations, or large master-planned developments**.
    
* Experience within City Operations, Traffic Operations, Transportation Management, Asset Management, or highway maintenance environments.
    
* Experience working within a **Traffic Management Center (TMC), Integrated Operations Center, or City Operations Command Center**.
    
* Professional certifications related to traffic engineering, road safety, ITS, transportation planning, or asset management are preferred.
    
* Advanced experience with traffic simulation platforms such as VISSIM, Aimsun, Synchro, or equivalent.
    
* Experience with GIS-based road network and asset management platforms.
    
* Knowledge of adaptive traffic signal control and smart intersection technologies.
    
* Experience integrating ITS devices and systems with centralized traffic or city management platforms.
    
* Knowledge of connected and autonomous vehicle (CAV) infrastructure and emerging smart mobility technologies.
    
* Experience developing traffic management strategies for stadiums, entertainment venues, festivals, sporting events, or other high-demand destinations.
    
* Experience managing road and ITS maintenance contractors against SLAs, KPIs, and asset performance requirements.
    
* Knowledge of pavement management systems, condition assessments, lifecycle planning, and preventive maintenance strategies.
    
* Experience using traffic analytics, dashboards, and business intelligence tools to improve network performance.
    
* Familiarity with Saudi road authority requirements and relevant MOTLS, municipality, and road safety standards.
    
* Experience working within Delivery Partner, PMC, client-side, or major program environments.
    
* Strong stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination capabilities.
    
* Ability to identify emerging network risks and recommend safe, resilient, and practical operational solutions.
    
* Commitment to road safety, network availability, asset reliability, smart mobility, and continuous improvement.

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Company Overview**

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

 **Overview – Role**

The **Fire Systems Engineer - Mechanical** will be a professional in the field of Fire Protection and Life Safety consulting with demonstrable experience in the design, construction and testing / commissioning phases of modern active fire protection systems.

Based in **Khobar**, this role will be responsible for working on wide range of projects based across Saudi Arabia.

This role offers the chance to work in a fast-paced environment and advance your career within a supportive and diverse team, to support the design and development of fire protection systems for a wide range of building types and industries. The ideal candidate is an early-career engineer with a strong interest in fire protection and a willingness to learn industry standards and software tools. A verifiable and demonstrated knowledge of design practices and approvals in KSA for Building Code and Life Safety requirements is a key requisite for this role. This also extends to the ability to engage and liaise with regulatory and approving authorities at various stages of design, construction and handover of projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design fire suppression systems such as firewater pump, firewater network, sprinkler system (wet, dry, pre-action), spray system, clean agent, kitchen hood system, etc.
* Design detailed fire alarm system drawings, wiring diagrams, device layouts, riser diagrams, cause and effect matrix, and specifications
* Perform voltage drop and battery calculations using specialized software (e.g., AlarmCAD, Honeywell tools)
* Prepare design basis report for fire suppression system
* Perform hydraulic calculations using software such as Elitefire and Pipenet
* Perform theoretical calculation and can verify /interpret the flow calculation for clean agent system
* Design/verify the kitchen hood fire extinguishing system
* Develop schematic diagrams for fire water pumps, fire water network, sprinkler system, spray system, foam system, etc.
* Prepare submittals, technical reports, and system documentation

description:
Business Need / Purpose of Role

The Senior Application Engineer is responsible for providing technical and commercial support for the selection, sizing, quoting, and application of centrifugal pump packages for Original Equipment (OE) projects. The role acts as the primary technical interface between customers, sales teams, and Trillium Pumps Italy during pre-order and bid execution stages.

The incumbent will review customer specifications, perform hydraulic and mechanical evaluations, develop technical proposals, ensure compliance with API, Saudi Aramco, and international standards, and support successful order acquisition for strategic projects across the oil & gas, petrochemical, water, power, and industrial sectors.

Key Responsibilities & Specific Accountabilities

Technical Application Engineering

• Review RFQs, customer specifications, data sheets, and project requirements.

• Perform pump sizing and hydraulic selection using approved engineering tools.

• Evaluate operating conditions, NPSH requirements, efficiency, and system performance.

• Select appropriate pump configurations, materials, seals, bearings, and auxiliary systems.

• Prepare technical deviations, clarifications, and compliance matrices.

• Ensure compliance with API 610, API 682, Saudi Aramco specifications, and customer requirements.

• Support engineering reviews associated with centrifugal pump packages and related rotating equipment.

Proposal & Commercial Support

• Prepare technical and commercial quotations within required deadlines.

• Develop cost estimates and coordinate pricing activities with internal departments.

• Participate in technical bid evaluations and customer clarification meetings.

• Support sales teams during customer presentations and project discussions.

• Assist in negotiation of technical aspects of contracts prior to award.

Project & Customer Interface

• Serve as the technical focal point for customers during the bidding phase.

• Coordinate with Trillium Pumps Italy engineering teams on complex applications.

• Attend customer meetings, kick-off meetings, and technical review sessions.

• Provide timely responses to customer technical queries.

• Build strong working relationships with Saudi Aramco, EPC contractors, consultants, and end users.

Continuous Improvement

• Maintain application engineering databases and selection records.

• Monitor market trends, customer requirements, and competitor technologies.

• Contribute to standardization and optimization of quoting processes.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase quotation accuracy and response times.

Quality, HSE & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with Company HSE policies and quality management systems.

• Promote a culture of safety, integrity, and technical excellence.

• Support ISO, API, and customer audit requirements when necessary.

Education

Essential

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

Preferred

• Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Rotating Equipment Engineering.

Experience

Essential

• Minimum 8-10 years of experience in pump application engineering, rotating equipment, or OEM engineering.

• Minimum 5 years of direct experience with centrifugal pumps and API 610 equipment.

• Experience supporting Saudi Aramco, SABIC, SWCC, SEC, or major EPC projects.

• Proven experience in technical bid preparation and execution of OE projects.

Preferred

• Experience with multinational pump OEMs.

• Experience coordinating with overseas engineering centers and manufacturing facilities.

Technical Competencies

• API 610 Centrifugal Pumps

• API 682 Mechanical Seals

• Hydraulic Pump Selection & Sizing

• Rotating Equipment Engineering

• Pump Performance Analysis

• Pump Testing & Acceptance Criteria

• Engineering Calculations

• Cost Estimation & Proposal Development

• Saudi Aramco Standards

• EPC Project Execution

Software Skills

• Microsoft Office Suite

• ERP Systems (SAP, Oracle, IFS or equivalent)

• Pump Selection Software

• AutoCAD (preferred)

• Engineering calculation tools

Behavioral Competencies

• Customer Focus

• Commercial Awareness

• Technical Excellence

• Problem Solving

• Effective Communication

• Teamwork & Collaboration

• Planning & Organization

• Ownership & Accountability

• Continuous Improvement Mindset

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• On-time quotation submission rate.

• Technical compliance percentage.

• Quote-to-order conversion ratio.

• Accuracy of engineering selections and costing.

• Customer satisfaction and responsiveness.

• Margin achievement against budget targets.

• Support to strategic project wins.

Description
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we are working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Are you ready to embrace the challenge? Come build the future with us.
This is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cutting-edge data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale, high-density facilities where you will help change the face of cloud technology in the region — and your work will directly impact millions of customers.
This internship is designed as a potential pathway to full-time employment. Interns who demonstrate strong performance throughout their internship may be considered for a full-time Data Center Technician position, subject to available roles and business needs.
Who Should Apply
We welcome applications from:
- Students in the last year of their Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar. It is a requirement to be graduated by the end of the internship.
Important — Site Location & Commuting: This role is based at a data center facility in a remote location with no public transportation access. A valid driving license and access to personal transportation are required to commute to the site daily. Please consider this before applying.
As a Data Center Technician Intern, you will work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure. This position involves hardware and network diagnostics followed by physical repair.
You will be exposed to both independent work and team-based collaboration. Prioritization, organizational skills, effective communication, and the ability to react quickly are critical to being successful.
What You Will Do
You will provide our internal teams with infrastructure-related support, resolving tickets related to hardware (motherboards, Random Access Memory, Central Processing Units, Graphics Processing Units, and more) and networking (link-down events, optics replacements, switch replacements, and more).
In addition to hardware and network repair, you will learn how to install equipment, create documentation, innovate solutions, and fix complex problems within the data center environment.
Your day-to-day duties include:
- Troubleshooting server hardware alongside experienced AWS technicians
- Meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) against assigned trouble tickets
- Shadowing AWS technicians during network troubleshooting to build your diagnostic skills
- Replacing media (Solid State Drives and Hard Disk Drives) in accordance with AWS Data Tech guidance
- Performing regular server hardware repairs (drives, motherboards, and other components) under the guidance of experienced technicians
- Interacting with third-party vendors and contractors working on site
Internship Structure
Amazon internships are full-time (40 hours per week) for 3 consecutive months, starting in summer 2027. This position requires the intern to report to work on site daily. Intern schedules are typically day schedules, Sunday through Thursday.
Please note that a full-time Data Center Technician position could involve day, evening, or weekend shifts and on-call rotations. Candidates should be willing and able to commit to shift work upon transitioning to a full-time position.
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed below, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, has not followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, do not let that stop you from applying.
Your Career at Amazon — A Universe of Opportunity
At Amazon, your career is not a straight path. It is a journey you build as you go.
From your first day as an intern, you will own real work that matters. You will diagnose and repair the servers and networks that keep AWS running for millions of customers. Your mentors and teammates will champion your growth, helping you build skills you did not know existed — and you will see your work come to life at massive scale.
Impact. Your work shapes the infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. Every server you repair and every network issue you resolve keeps the cloud running.
Action. You will move fast, learn by doing, and solve real problems from day one. Your ideas do not get stuck in approval chains — they get tested, refined, and put into practice.
Curiosity. Every project teaches you something new. You will apply what you learned in the classroom to real challenges and explore different teams, technologies, and career paths within Amazon.
Mentorship and career growth. You will start with structured onboarding and get paired with experienced mentors. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members in an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing. Projects and tasks are assigned in a way that leverages your strengths and helps you further develop your skill set. Your journey here is yours to shape.
About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We are the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.
You will join a diverse team of engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You will collaborate with people across AWS to deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers.
Basic Qualifications
- In pursuit of a Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Hardware Repair, or similar, graduating in 2027 – before the internship´s end date.
- Professional English proficiency, both written and verbal
- Ability to work well with others in a team environment, with strong time management skills
Preferred Qualifications
- Basic knowledge of Linux and networking
- Basic knowledge of computer hardware components
- Ability to manage work and priorities through a ticketing system and coordination with Manager.
- An interest in computer sciences and information technology
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
