job_title: BMS / SCADA Specialist- Data Center Specialist
description:
## Company Description

*SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over 2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries, supported by a team of 99,500 dedicated professionals. With over 145 years of service excellence, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve the highest standards of quality, compliance, and sustainability.*

We are looking for BMS / SCADA Specialist who will be responsible for the design review, configuration, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover of Building Management System (BMS) and SCADA systems for data center and mission‑critical projects in KSA.The role requires strong hands-on expertise in control systems, system integration, data visualization, and close coordination with MEP, commissioning, IT, and operations teams to ensure reliable and fully functional monitoring and control systems.

## Job Description

* Lead and execute BMS and SCADA activities across the full project lifecycle, including design review, configuration, installation support, testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and final handover.
* Review and validate BMS / SCADA architecture, points lists, network topology, control schematics, sequences of operation, and graphics to ensure alignment with project requirements and data center best practices.
* Configure, program, test, and troubleshoot BMS and SCADA systems, including controllers, servers, field devices, HMIs, databases, and alarm management systems.
* Integrate BMS and SCADA with data center critical systems, including electrical (UPS, generators, switchgear, power meters), mechanical (HVAC, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units), fire alarm systems, BMS subsystems, DCIM, and third‑party systems using standard protocols (BACnet, Modbus, SNMP, OPC).
* Support and participate in Integrated Systems Testing (IST) to validate control logic, alarms, interlocks, failover scenarios, redundancy, and operational sequences.
* Coordinate closely with commissioning managers, MEP engineers, system vendors, OEMs, IT/network teams, contractors, and client representatives.
* Witness and support FAT, SAT, and site testing, ensuring all observations are recorded and resolved.
* Develop, review, and maintain BMS / SCADA documentation, including system configuration records, test results, alarm matrices, trend logs, backups, and sign‑off documents.
* Ensure BMS and SCADA systems comply with project specifications, international standards, cybersecurity practices (where applicable), and local KSA regulations.
* Monitor and enforce HSE requirements during all testing and commissioning activities.
* Support preparation of O&M manuals, operator training, system demonstrations, and final handover to facility operations teams.
* Assist with post‑handover support, fine‑tuning, and optimization during initial operations if required.

## Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in BMS / SCADA systems
* 3–5+ years of experience on data center or mission‑critical projects preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience with BMS and SCADA platforms (e.g., Siemens, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, ABB, Rockwell)
* Proficiency in industrial communication protocols (BACnet IP/MSTP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC, SNMP)
* Good understanding of data center operations, redundancy concepts (N, N+1, 2N), and alarm management
* Ability to read and interpret control drawings, network diagrams, and sequences of operation

## Additional Information

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a talented Customer Solutions Manager to play a key role in the Customer Solutions team. You have a strong history with Telecom RF& Machine Learning and ideally, you have some experience with SQL, Python & Tableau when needed. You’ll be instrumental in delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our users and clients. We value curiosity, innovation and willingness to continuously learn new technologies.
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the success of a rapidly growing company with a global footprint.

We foster a flexible, inclusive work environment that values creativity, collaboration, and individual expression. If you’re excited about solving complex Wi-Fi networking challenges for customers and driven by customer success, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary, dedicated point of contact for many of Ookla’s highest valued customers

• Actively develop and grow relationships across your customer’s business and technical organizations

• Educate, train, and support our clients to ensure optimum utilization of our product suite

• Act as the primary resolution function for any issues or questions raised by your customers

• Personally troubleshoot customer-facing business and technical issues, and drive issue escalation within Ookla as needed

• Engage with Director and C-Level executives in support of their business needs

• Partner internally with the sales team to periodically review account health and identify opportunities for future growth within your accounts, and assist with pre-sales activities

• Champion and advocate for customer requirements within Ookla (be their voice)

• Participate in customer requested meetings (onsite or via phone)

• Continually develop your own knowledge and application of new technologies to support and enable growth of our customers

• Think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges as you help our customers take advantage of Ookla’s data products.

• Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency in reporting, analysis, customer communication, and internal workflows.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across customer success, technical analysis, and operational processes.

• Support the development of AI-assisted dashboards, summaries, insights, and executive-ready outputs.

• Use AI to accelerate market analysis, customer benchmarking, root-cause investigation, and trend identification.

• Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to explore AI-driven use cases that improve customer value.

Job Qualifications

We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your life experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

• 5 - 10 years of enterprise-level, technology-related support or account management experience

• Exceptional customer focus and bias for action

• Experience supporting nascent products/services into new markets is strongly desired

• Adept at establishing and developing relationships across customer organizations

• Strong technical problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly

• Experience with data analytics, including applications like Tableau, SQL and advanced Excel functions

• Experience visualizing big data to demonstrate value and quality to customers

• Experience in Data Modelling and AI & ML desirable.

• Familiarity with internet, cellular and broadband technology and infrastructure

• At least some experience with RAN/RF

• Self-motivated with a track record of appropriate urgency and follow-through

• Strong verbal and written communications skills with both clients and internal audiences, able to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization

• Knowledge and expertise with Ookla’s product offerings, including our licensing, data, and awards, or experience with similar technology-based product offerings

• Ability to travel regularly to meet and connect with existing clients, and to attend Ookla corporate and team functions

• Strategic thinker with the ability to see/understand the big picture

• Global business experience a plus, with special focus on supporting the needs of an international customer base

• Technical Program or Project Management experience a plus

• B.A./B.S. degree or equivalent, Master’s degree or international business education a plus

About
Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

Compensation Range

Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is 360,000 - 450,000 SAR . Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,500 hotels in operation and under development in 95+ countries. The Group’s overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature Yes I Can! service ethos.

As **A/C Technician/ VRVA/**, you will join a team that is passionate about delivering incredible service where we believe that anything is possible, whilst having fun in all that we do!

## Qualifications

* Similar past experiences An eye for detail.
* Is a creative problem-solver.
* Passionate about creating extraordinary service.
* Ability to work as part of a team to ensure guest satisfaction.
* Located in Jeddah

**Live the Magic of Hospitality -** Be part of a team that creates **exceptional experiences and memorable moments** every day. Let your **Yes I Can!** spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

**Build a Great Career -** No matter your background or experience, we invest in your **growth, learning, and career development**—helping you reach your full potential.

**Experience the Team Spirit -** Join a workplace that’s **inclusive, fun, and meaningful**. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our **Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives**.

**Lead with Your Ambition -** Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to **make a difference**—in hospitality, your community and beyond.

**Enjoy Global & Local Perks -** No matter where you’re located, you’ll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you’ll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

**Join us in shaping the future of hospitality!** If you’re ready to **bring your talent, energy, and passion**, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply now and let’s make every moment matter.**

We welcome applicants from all **backgrounds, abilities, and experiences**. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

description:
Job Description

At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.”
What if your ideas could ignite global innovation?
What if your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of your career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect 70% of the Fortune 500, and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

Here, how we empower our people is extraordinary: Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and Cigna Healthy Workforce honors three years running — and what we build is world-class: recognized as CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024 — evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next”.

In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox.

Senior Professional Services Consultant

We have an opportunity for a Senior Professional Services Consultant to join our Professional Services Solutions team located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, reporting to the Director of Professional Services Solutions for EMEA. In this pivotal role, you will work to accelerate customer adoption of our products by providing installation services and technical leadership to our customers. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a strong, growing, successful, and innovative organization. Infoblox allows you to thrive in a unique work environment where the emphasis is on career growth, excellence, innovation, and collaboration. You’re the ideal candidate if you have experience with software development, networking, and/or security, and are dedicated to providing outstanding customer service and satisfaction. You will be expected to hit billable utilization targets as well as for ways to add value to our customers.

Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do

Understand customer business requirements, pain-points, and be able to translate them into actionable implementation projects

Work closely with customers and other Infoblox Professional Services team members to meet customer technical and business challenges utilizing Infoblox products (NIOS, UniversalDDI, Infoblox Threat Defense) as quickly as possible

Create project technical documentation

Perform Infoblox upgrades/refreshes for customer environments

Ensure projects complete successfully, on time and on budget, achieving project goals with a customer satisfaction score of 95 or above

Leverage AI-powered tools and insights to enhance customer discovery, accelerate services scoping, improve proposal quality, and drive efficient pre-sales engagement while maintaining sound professional judgment and customer focus

Mentor customers on Infoblox technology as part of project delivery

Mentor Infoblox Skilled to Secure partners on Infoblox implementation best practices

Contribute to the Professional Services knowledge base

Establish outstanding relationships, trust, and collaboration with the regional Professional Services, Support, and Sales teams

Be Prepared — What You Bring

3+ years in professional services delivery and consulting; Infoblox, BlueCat, or Palo Alto Networks experience is a plus

Experience working in a SaaS networking and/or software security is a plus

Experience with DNS, DHCP, and IP address management is a plus

Experience with DevOps tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, etc. is a plus

Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, and Azure) is a plus

Excellent communication skills, influencing skills, and the ability to present at internal and external meetings

A customer-centric mindset, and the willingness to take initiative to do the right thing for the customer

Good technical knowledge of security concepts and implementations/products is an added advantage

Ability for up to 40% travel

A minimum of a bachelor’s degree (BA or BS), or equivalent experience

Be Successful — Your Path

First 90 Days:

Immerse yourself in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work

Discuss and create short/long term goals

Six Months:

Work closely with Infoblox customers to implement our solutions.

Complete / attain significant progress in certification for Infoblox products

Meet metrics for utilization and customer satisfaction

One Year:

Be a trusted technical resource for Infoblox products for implementation and consulting

Be comfortable implementing projects in the full lifecycle of Infoblox Standard Migration Methodology

Contribute to the Professional Services knowledge base

Belong— Your Community

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong

Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options

Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops

Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy

Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks (and the occasional cupcake), plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations

Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

Ready to Be the Difference?

Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis

description:
CoorB is all about digital finance. We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

ABOUT **CoorB**  

We build full-fledged innovative solutions with a focus on process automation, user experience enhancement, and advanced data analytics. With our extensive industry expertise, we help achieve operational excellence, future-proof your IT investments, and ensure a competitive edge in the ever-evolving finance industry.  

   

OUR OPPORTUNITY  

We are looking for a Senior UX Researcher to establish and run research and usability activities for complex digital banking journeys across retail and corporate segments. The role will generate customer insights, validate designs, evaluate implemented experiences, and support evidence-based decisions across Arabic and English experiences.  

YOU WILL  

»       Plan and conduct qualitative and quantitative UX research aligned with business and design decisions.  

»       Define research questions, methods, participant profiles, and study objectives.  

»       Recruit, screen, and moderate research sessions in Arabic and English.  

»       Conduct moderated and unmoderated usability testing using task-based protocols.  

»       Evaluate existing journeys through expert reviews, analytics, complaints, and customer evidence.  

»       Conduct heuristic and accessibility evaluations, including manual keyboard and screen-reader testing.  

»       Analyse digital adoption, abandonment, task success, errors, satisfaction, and other behavioural metrics.  

»       Conduct competitive benchmarking across relevant banking and digital experiences.  

»       Develop customer segments, personas, and moments-of-truth insights where required.  

»       Translate research findings into clear, actionable design decisions within Agile sprint cycles.  

»       Maintain research documentation, evidence, repositories, and decision traceability.  

»       Apply appropriate privacy, consent, security, data-retention, and research-operation standards.  

»       Distinguish usability issues from design, content, accessibility, system, and software defects.  

»       Conduct re-testing and provide evidence for resolving high-severity findings.  

»       Present findings to design, business, technology, and compliance stakeholders.  

»       Mentor junior researchers and support knowledge transfer to client teams.  

  

  
### Requirements

»       TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THE ROLE YOU NEED  

»       6–10 years of UX research experience, including 3+ years in enterprise, financial services, or regulated products.  

»       Fluent Arabic and English with proven experience moderating research in both languages.  

»       Strong mixed-method research experience across qualitative and quantitative approaches.  

»       Proven experience conducting usability testing with objective measures and task-based protocols.  

»       Experience with research recruitment, consent, scheduling, incentives, and data handling under formal privacy controls.  

»       Strong skills in heuristic evaluation, accessibility evaluation, analytics, and behavioural-data interpretation.  

»       Experience establishing or maintaining research repositories.  

»       Strong analytical, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.  

»       Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.  

»       GCC/KSA banking, fintech, or regulated-sector experience is an advantage.  

»       Knowledge of UX design and WCAG 2.2 AA is a plus.  

»       Experience researching customers with different accessibility needs is an advantage.  

»       Experience with surveys, statistical analysis, or establishing research capabilities is a plus.  

»       Degree or diploma in HCI, Psychology, Social Sciences, Human Factors, Design, or a related field.

description:
The Opportunity:

We are looking for a talented Customer Solutions Manager to play a key role in the Customer Solutions team. You have a strong history with Telecom RF& Machine Learning and ideally, you have some experience with SQL, Python & Tableau when needed. You’ll be instrumental in delivering high-quality solutions that meet the needs of our users and clients. We value curiosity, innovation and willingness to continuously learn new technologies.
This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in the success of a rapidly growing company with a global footprint.

We foster a flexible, inclusive work environment that values creativity, collaboration, and individual expression. If you’re excited about solving complex Wi-Fi networking challenges for customers and driven by customer success, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary, dedicated point of contact for many of Ookla’s highest valued customers

• Actively develop and grow relationships across your customer’s business and technical organizations

• Educate, train, and support our clients to ensure optimum utilization of our product suite

• Act as the primary resolution function for any issues or questions raised by your customers

• Personally troubleshoot customer-facing business and technical issues, and drive issue escalation within Ookla as needed

• Engage with Director and C-Level executives in support of their business needs

• Partner internally with the sales team to periodically review account health and identify opportunities for future growth within your accounts, and assist with pre-sales activities

• Champion and advocate for customer requirements within Ookla (be their voice)

• Participate in customer requested meetings (onsite or via phone)

• Continually develop your own knowledge and application of new technologies to support and enable growth of our customers

• Think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges as you help our customers take advantage of Ookla’s data products.

• Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency in reporting, analysis, customer communication, and internal workflows.

• Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across customer success, technical analysis, and operational processes.

• Support the development of AI-assisted dashboards, summaries, insights, and executive-ready outputs.

• Use AI to accelerate market analysis, customer benchmarking, root-cause investigation, and trend identification.

• Collaborate with product, data, and engineering teams to explore AI-driven use cases that improve customer value.

Job Qualifications

We are looking for the right person, not the exact list of requirements. If you believe your life experience has prepared you for similar challenges, we’d like to hear from you.

• 5 - 10 years of enterprise-level, technology-related support or account management experience

• Exceptional customer focus and bias for action

• Experience supporting nascent products/services into new markets is strongly desired

• Adept at establishing and developing relationships across customer organizations

• Strong technical problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt to new technologies and learn quickly

• Experience with data analytics, including applications like Tableau, SQL and advanced Excel functions

• Experience visualizing big data to demonstrate value and quality to customers

• Experience in Data Modelling and AI & ML desirable.

• Familiarity with internet, cellular and broadband technology and infrastructure

• At least some experience with RAN/RF

• Self-motivated with a track record of appropriate urgency and follow-through

• Strong verbal and written communications skills with both clients and internal audiences, able to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization

• Knowledge and expertise with Ookla’s product offerings, including our licensing, data, and awards, or experience with similar technology-based product offerings

• Ability to travel regularly to meet and connect with existing clients, and to attend Ookla corporate and team functions

• Strategic thinker with the ability to see/understand the big picture

• Global business experience a plus, with special focus on supporting the needs of an international customer base

• Technical Program or Project Management experience a plus

• B.A./B.S. degree or equivalent, Master’s degree or international business education a plus

About
Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.

About Accenture
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com .

Compensation Range

Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is 360,000 - 450,000 SAR . Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

## **What is the role**

description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

**Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Manager– Hospitality Digital Systems & Data** to join our team! In this role you will get to collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, maintain system integrity and support automation, translating technical outputs into clear, user-friendly insights to enable effective decision-making. You will also support the rollout and adoption of digital tools through training, documentation and troubleshooting, ensuring systems remain aligned with evolving business requirements.

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Define and support the development of digital platform structures and data models, ensuring systems (e.g. SharePoint, Aconex) are scalable, well-organised and aligned with business and reporting requirements
* Gather and document business requirements, translating operational needs into system configurations, enhancements and digital solutions
* Administer and maintain digital systems and data environments, ensuring data is accurate, accessible, governed and aligned with business standards
* Support reporting and analytics by structuring data, enabling data integration and contributing to dashboards and visualisations (e.g. Power BI)
* Develop and support automation of data processes and workflows using Microsoft tools and scripting (e.g. Power Automate, Python, SQL)
* Support the implementation and adoption of digital tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with business processes and effective user engagement
* Manage document control platforms (e.g. Aconex), ensuring compliance, consistency and effective information management
* Translate technical outputs into clear, user-friendly formats to support reporting, documentation and communication
* Collaborate across teams to enable seamless data flow and integration across systems, reporting and project activities
* Support end-users through training, guidance and troubleshooting, promoting effective use of systems and tools
* Contribute to continuous improvement of systems, tools and processes to enhance efficiency, automation and data-driven decision-making

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline (or equivalent experience)
* Minimum 15 years experience in digital systems, data platforms or reporting environments, ideally within project or delivery settings
* Certifications in Microsoft 365, Power Platform or data analytics tools preferred
* Professional membership or recognized certification preferred (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent)
* Strong understanding and experience using digital platforms and data systems, including Microsoft 365 suite (e.g. SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Power Automate) to support integrated workflows
* Strong understanding of SharePoint Online, including site structure, permissions, content management and platform configuration
* Knowledge of Windows Server and IIS for managing SharePoint environments
* Ability to work with structured and unstructured data, supporting data processing, reporting and analysis
* Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.g. Power Automate, Python, SQL) to support workflow automation and system enhancements
* Experience supporting document control and project systems with focus on data quality and compliance
* Proactive and adaptable, able to operate effectively in fast-paced environments
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, translating technical concepts into clear, practical outputs
* Analytical and problem-solving mindset, identifying issues and driving solutions
* Collaborative, working effectively across teams and stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, ensuring data accuracy and system integrity
* Well-organised, able to prioritise workload and manage competing demands

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Experience supporting digital systems, reporting platforms or data environments in a project or operational setting
* Experience contributing to dashboards, reporting and data visualisation (e.g. Power BI)
* Familiarity with project and document management platforms (e.g. Aconex, Microsoft Project, Primavera or similar)
* Exposure to system enhancements, platform rollouts or digital tool implementations preferred
* Experience working within project, construction or development environments preferred
* Key relationships with stakeholders, including: Consultants and Suppliers, Delivery Partners / Project Management Consultants

Qiddiya Investment Company is on the hunt for a highly skilled and visionary Senior Manager - Cybersecurity Risk Management to lead our cybersecurity initiatives in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. This critical role will involve overseeing the development and implementation of a robust cybersecurity risk management strategy that safeguards our assets while ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

You will be tasked with identifying and mitigating cybersecurity risks, fostering a culture of security awareness, and leading a team dedicated to maintaining the integrity and security of our information systems. Your expertise will be essential in shaping the direction of our cybersecurity posture in alignment with our business objectives.

### Key Responsibilities

* Develop and implement a comprehensive cybersecurity risk management framework tailored to organizational needs and regulatory requirements.
* Lead risk assessments and vulnerability assessments to identify threats and exposures associated with information systems.
* Oversee the creation and maintenance of a cybersecurity risk register, tracking and reporting on identified risks and mitigation efforts.
* Collaborate with IT, legal, and compliance teams to ensure that cybersecurity measures align with overall enterprise risk management strategies.
* Drive the development and execution of training and awareness programs to ensure all employees understand their role in cybersecurity risk management.
* Prepare and present detailed reports on cybersecurity risks and compliance to executive leadership and stakeholders.
* Stay abreast of emerging cybersecurity threats and trends, providing strategic guidance to adapt risk management practices accordingly.
* Mentor and lead the cybersecurity risk management team, ensuring their professional growth and expertise in the field.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.
* 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity risk management or related roles, with substantial experience in leadership positions.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, methodologies, and industry best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT).
* Expertise in risk assessment methodologies and risk mitigation strategies.
* Relevant certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), or equivalent are highly desirable.
* Exceptional analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* A proactive and strategic mindset, capable of navigating complex challenges in cybersecurity.

**Benefits**

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

description:
About this Position
As an On-Site Application Engineer, you will represent Henkel at one of our key customer's manufacturing facilities in Jeddah, providing hands-on technical support and ensuring the optimal performance of Henkel's adhesive solutions throughout the production process.
This role requires a strong technical background, a proactive problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams to maintain production efficiency, resolve application challenges, and drive continuous process improvements

What you´ll do

• Maintain a full-time presence at the customer's automotive manufacturing facility in Jeddah, serving as Henkel's primary on-site technical representative.

• Provide daily hands-on technical support for Henkel's automotive adhesive and bonding applications, ensuring optimal product performance and smooth integration into manufacturing processes.

• Monitor adhesive application performance and critical process parameters, including temperature, pressure, dispensing accuracy, curing conditions, and bonding quality to ensure stable and efficient production.

• Identify, investigate, and troubleshoot technical challenges related to adhesive applications, bonding performance, equipment functionality, and manufacturing processes.

• Conduct root cause analysis and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with the customer's technical teams and Henkel's internal experts to minimize production disruptions.

• Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Process Engineering teams to ensure consistent application quality, process reliability, and compliance with automotive manufacturing standards.

• Support adhesive product trials, application validations, process improvements, and the introduction of new bonding technologies within the customer's production lines.

• Act as the key technical liaison between Henkel and the customer, ensuring effective communication, timely issue resolution, and alignment on technical requirements.

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with key customer stakeholders, including engineering teams, production supervisors, quality representatives, and plant management.

• Prepare and maintain technical reports, performance assessments, troubleshooting documentation, corrective action plans, and regular project updates for both Henkel and customer stakeholders.

• Coordinate with Henkel's Application Engineering, Technical Service, Sales, and Product Development teams to provide technical solutions and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Ensure adherence to applicable health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements while working within the customer's manufacturing environment.

What makes you a good fit

• Minimum of 2–3 years of hands-on experience in automotive manufacturing, preferably within production, process engineering, application engineering, or technical support.

• Experience working in an automotive manufacturing plant, with a good understanding of production processes, quality standards, and operational requirements.

• Knowledge of industrial adhesives, bonding technologies, surface treatments, or automotive assembly processes is highly desirable.

• Strong technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify process deviations and implement effective corrective actions.

• Ability to read and interpret technical specifications, engineering drawings, process parameters, and production performance data.

• Familiarity with automotive quality standards, continuous improvement methodologies, and manufacturing best practices.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer relationship management skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently in a customer-facing manufacturing environment.

• Willingness to be based full-time at the customer's manufacturing facility in Jeddah, with occasional travel for technical training, meetings, or support at other customer locations.

• Fluent English is required; Arabic is an advantage.

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We look for a diverse team of individuals who possess different backgrounds, experiences, personalities and mindsets.

Reboot Monkey is a global leader in data center services, operating in 166 countries and over 2,300 cities worldwide . Our mission: "3 engineers within 1 hour of every data center globally."

Remote Hands & Smart Hands support (cabling, power cycling, hardware swaps)

Server rack installation and decommissioning

Cross-connect and patch panel management

Hardware troubleshooting and diagnostics

Visual inspections and inventory audits

Escort and access coordination for client visits

Emergency response and on-call availability

Hands-on experience with data center infrastructure

Knowledge of server hardware, networking, and cabling standards

Reliable transportation and proximity to local data centers

Strong communication skills in English

Ability to lift 25kg+ equipment

Flexible availability including weekends/holidays for urgent requests

Certifications: CompTIA Server+, Network+, CDCP, CCNA

Experience at major DC providers (Equinix, Digital Realty, NTT, CyrusOne)

Structured cabling expertise (fiber, Cat6, DAC)

description:
**About The Company**

Jeeny is a leading ride-hailing platform that strives to revolutionize daily commuting and transportation. Our app connects users with their preferred modes of transportation, making mobility accessible, convenient, and affordable for all.

We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Since our inception, we have grown exponentially and currently operate in Saudi Arabia and Jordan with making an impact in the lives of more than 45 million people.

At Jeeny, we value innovation, teamwork, and passion for delivering exceptional user experiences. Join us in our mission to transform the mobility landscape.

**About the role:**

As the Growth Manager - Insights & Analytics, you will play a pivotal role within the commercial team: the strategic engine powering our marketplace expansion. You’ll translate complex data into actionable insights that drive high-impact growth initiatives and inform strategic decisions. Partnering closely with Marketing, Product, and Operations, you’ll lead CRM and DRM strategies while managing growth spends to maximize ROI. You’ll also oversee budget allocation to ensure every marketing dollar and incentive delivers measurable sustainable growth and long-term profitability.

**Responsibilities:**

CRM/DRM Strategy & Lifecycle Management

* Lifecycle Campaign Development: Design and execute lifecycle campaigns for both passengers and partners - spanning onboarding, activation, reactivation, retention, and overall engagement across multi-channel touchpoints (in-app, push, email, SMS).
* Segmentation & Personalization: Build dynamic segmentation models leveraging RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) and behavioral data to tailor messaging, incentives, and experiences that maximize engagement and loyalty across both sides of the marketplace.
* Performance Analysis: Continuously monitor CRM/DRM performance metrics, translate insights into actionable improvements, and optimize campaign ROI through data-backed iteration.

* Continuous experimentation: (A/B, multivariate, incentive, and journey tests) to uncover high-impact growth levers across the user and partner lifecycle.
* Touch True Marketplace Levers: Monitor and analyze key marketplace metrics, identifying friction points and opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, reactivation and retention..
* Advanced Analytics: Leverage advanced analytics and funnel modeling to enhance conversion efficiency across the entire user/partner journey.
* Incrementality Testing: Apply incrementality and cohort analyses to measure true impact of growth initiatives and guide resource allocation.
* Data to Strategy: Synthesize insights into clear, actionable strategies that inform leadership decisions and drive sustainable marketplace growth.
* Playbook Creation: Build scalable growth playbooks that codify both wins and misses - turning 5/5 successes into repeatable frameworks and 0/5 failures into data-backed lessons that sharpen Jeeny’s experimentation muscle

Competitive Intelligence & Growth Strategy

* Market Pulse: Continuously analyze competitor growth initiatives — such as engagement mechanics, incentive structures, and marketplace strategies to uncover opportunities to strengthen user and partner retention.
* Translate competitive insights into actionable growth plays, influencing lifecycle strategies, incentive design, and experimentation priorities.
* Use trend analysis and data modeling to forecast competitive movements and guide long-term growth investments and priorities.

  
Forecasting Models & Predictive Analytics

* Build intelligent forecasting models to predict marketplace trends:  from active users and engaged partners to trip demand, retention rates, and incentive efficiency - enabling smarter, faster growth decisions.
* Turn predictions into strategy: empowering teams to act proactively, drive sustainable growth, and keep the marketplace ahead of shifting behaviors and competitive dynamics.

Automation & Scalability

* Design and implement automated workflows to streamline reporting, campaign execution, and performance tracking across CRM and DRM initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product and Data teams to build scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and decision-support tools that enable real-time visibility into growth metrics.
* Automate experimentation and lifecycle triggers, ensuring consistent, timely, and personalized user and partner engagement.
* Standardize analytics and growth frameworks across markets, reducing manual dependency and improving operational efficiency.

  
Budget Management:

* Own the growth budgeting cycle, ensuring optimal allocation of incentives, marketing, and CRM/DRM spend.
* Track performance against budgets, highlighting ROI, efficiency gains, and areas for reallocation.
* Develop data-driven strategies that maximize financial impact while mitigating operational and growth risks.

People Management:

* Lead a team of high-performing individuals, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and track OKRs, aligning team objectives with strategic growth priorities.
* Enable high performance through coaching, feedback loops, and clear accountability.
* Foster innovation and collaboration by empowering talent and promoting continuous learning.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Business, Analytics, Economics, or a quantitative discipline.
* At least 5 years experience in an analytical role dealing with large volumes of data, Experience in pricing/discount strategy and/or on-demand is a plus preferably in mobility, e-commerce, or marketplace sectors
* Solid grasp of statistics and demonstrated experience with A/B testing
* Amazing SQL and Excel skills. Experience with Python or R is a plus
* Experience with some BI tools and data visualization like Tableau, Power BI or Looker
* Experience with CRM tools (Braze, Salesforce, HubSpot, Clevertap) and/or marketing automation platforms.
* Excellent communication skills; able to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Benefits**

**Why Join Us**

You’ll lead a team that sits at the heart of the company’s growth engine - where data meets creativity, and strategy meets execution.

At Jeeny, you’ll have the freedom to innovate, experiment, and build systems that directly shape how millions of users and partners interact with our application every day.

***This is more than analytics - it’s impact at scale.***

description:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
Associate Consultant Intern, Summer 2027 – Saudi Arabia
Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining Why join Mastercard’s internship program?
Mastercard's internship program offers more than hands-on work. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities. It provides an opportunity to build skills, expand your network, and make a meaningful impact while working on projects that support business priorities.
About the team
Mastercard’s Advisors & Consulting Services (A&CS) team helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.
What you’ll do
As an Associate Consultant Intern, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality, and more.
You will:
Work in small teams to support strategic consulting projects across industries
Collaborate with colleagues across different areas of the organization and gain exposure to business development, account management, and product management
Analyze data, identify trends, and help translate insights into recommendations
Create clear and compelling presentations for internal teams and clients
Support problem solving by structuring challenges and exploring solutions
Build an understanding of how consulting engagements are delivered end to end
Participate in volunteer and team building experiences
Gain exposure to our leadership team through networking sessions and speaker series
Begin to build relationships with clients to understand their business needs, seek strategic solutions and guide impactful decisions
Grow by receiving hands-on mentorship from an experienced management team
Specialization Tracks
We are looking for passionate and talented professionals who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs. We are recruiting five specialization tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.
Business Experimentation
Leverage Mastercard's industry-leading predictive analytics platform, Test & Learn®, and SQL to run data-backed business experiments for our clients. Consultants focus on data science-based solutions to provide insights on various business initiatives, including product launches, marketing campaigns, customer loyalty, and pricing across various industries that touch many Fortune 500 companies. Partner directly with clients to share findings and help determine which ideas are effective, as well as where, when, and how to implement them.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?
What bonus should be provided to someone opening a credit card account to entice them to use the card regularly?
Strategy & Transformation
Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?
How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial, and strategic goals?
Performance Analytics
Use quantitative and qualitative skills and enterprise applications (e.g., Business Intelligence Platforms, SQL, Python, and more) to drive data-led consulting solutions for customers. Weave together vast amounts of Mastercard, client & 3rd party data assets to investigate trends, build propensity models, develop data visualizations, and synthesize millions of data points into a cohesive story. Engage with client stakeholders through virtual and in-person meetings, leveraging insights to inform strategic recommendations.
Sampling of questions we help our customers answer:
How does a financial institution fraud/authorization metrics fare against competitors, and what are strategies that can help it be best-in-class?
How is a technology customer’s market share changing over time, and are there any segments where the client is relatively under penetrated?
Marketing
Develop strategies and lead implementation of marketing campaigns and engagements; evaluate results to drive performance on behalf of Mastercard’s clients. Provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, leveraging customer, behavioral and transactional data and defining tangible results to both the client and Mastercard.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How does a fintech client optimize new customer acquisition and existing customers’ life cycle value through effective targeting and communications?
How does a retail client drive foot traffic into store post-covid and/or optimize their ecommerce website to increase basket-size and average spend per customer?
How can a large financial institution best execute a portfolio conversion – for example, after purchasing another issuer’s portfolio – including components like internal and external communications, market launch, and more?
Deploy
Help clients implement, launch, and scale Mastercard products, platforms, and business transformation initiatives. Combine program management, stakeholder engagement, and implementation expertise to guide complex initiatives from strategy into execution.
Work closely with client and Mastercard teams, coordinate cross-functional efforts, manage risks and dependencies, and drive adoption to ensure clients realize value from their investments.
Sampling of questions we help our clients answer:
How can a financial institution successfully implement and launch a new payments, fraud, or digital banking solution while minimizing disruption to customers and internal teams?
What governance structure, implementation roadmap, and stakeholder engagement plan will best position a client to deliver a large-scale transformation on time and within scope?
How can a client accelerate adoption and maximize the value of a newly deployed platform, product, or technology investment across its organization?
As an intern, you'll benefit from
Mentorship and coaching from experienced professionals and leaders
Networking opportunities with fellow interns, employees, and senior leaders
Professional development experiences focused on career growth and skill-building
Exposure to innovative technologies and global business challenges
Volunteer, community engagement, and team-building activities
What we’re looking for
Undergraduate or master’s degree with an expected graduation date between Dec 2027-July 2028
Language Proficiency:
Proficiency in English is mandatory
Proficiency in two or more languages is considered a strong plus.
Availability: Must be available to start the internship on June 2027
We recruit for and value the following core competencies:
Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.
Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical, and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).
Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.
Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.
Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.
Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.
Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.
Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Many of our interns continue building their careers with Mastercard through full-time opportunities, early career programs, or future internships.
To participate in our job simulation and experience what it’s like to work as a Consultant at Mastercard visit: https://www.theforage.com/simulations/mastercard/advisors-client-services-xvlw
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
+ Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
+ Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
+ Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
+ Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!

At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. **Job Description:**

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented **Senior Systems Engineer - SCADA Expertise and OCC** to join our team!

**What You'll Be Doing:**

* Preparation of rules and procedures for Operations, CBTC systems and regulation.
* Requirements management including refinement and traceability
* System performance
* Analyze design options and specifications
* Development of safety/operational concept
* Lead the design review, from an operational and maintenance perceptive, of SCADA, MMIS and related sub-systems and more specifically lead the review of the SCADA design submitted by the Design & Built Contractor
* Test cases for implementation during the commissioning and acceptance of SCADA system.
* Review and approval of the operational safety case.
* Review OCC layout in accordance with the task analysis.
* Review the contract and the specification that the supplier has given to make sure that it matches the requirements.
* Reviewing the Factory Acceptance Test Procedure and Plans to ensure the compliance with the contract
* Meeting with the design and build contractors and the supplier to make sure all are in compliance and changes are within the scope of the supplier and the contractors.
* Facilitate and Participate to the Factory Acceptance Test of the SCADA system
* Preparing reports, request for more information and letters to the client for clarifications that may arise.
* Utilizing EDMS System (Aconex, PCM) for document control and making submittals to the contractor.
* Assisting other Systems Team Members on their subsystems as it interfaces with SCADA.
* Assist in preparation of Emergency Response Plan.
* Train Junior Engineers (Saudi National)

**What Required Skills You'll Bring:**

  

* With minimum of 12 years work experience in Metro Control Center Operations
* Extensive experience in Operations and Maintenance
* Large project experience in role of Systems Engineer
* Operation Control Center experience
* Rail/Metro industry background required
* Rail Systems, ERTMS, Asset Protection, Systems Engineering, Operations development and SCADA
* Understand maintenance concept and RAMS requirement.
* Chartered Engineer

 **What Desired Skills You'll Bring:**

* Good communication skills both written and verbal
* Background includes project experience in rail/metro industry
* Working knowledge of CBTC, MMIS, SCADA and Networking Functions.

## Company Description

At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.

Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.

This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.

We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.

What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.

If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.

What We Are Looking For

Check Point is seeking a high-energy Territory Manager to accelerate new and expansion business across a broad geographic territory of unassigned Rest-of-Market accounts, with channel partners at the center of the growth strategy. In this role, you will turn market opportunity into measurable pipeline by building a smart, data-driven territory plan, activating partner-led co-sell motions, sparking demand through impactful trainings and seminars, and driving a fast-moving pipeline at scale.

* Drive disciplined territory planning and coverage priorities
    

* Execute partner-led co-sell motions with Channel Partners & PSMs
    

* Conduct partner training, seminars and enablement sessions

* Highly organized and energized by managing a high-volume book of opportunities, not just accounts.

Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?

If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,[webook.com](http://webook.com/) is Saudi's #1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.

### Key Responsibilities & Technical Focus Areas

**Leadership & Team Enablement**

* Lead and enable engineering teams, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and technical excellence.
* Define and communicate the technical vision, priorities, and roadmap, aligning engineering efforts with business goals.
* Provide guidance and mentorship on architecture, system design, and technical decision-making.
* Drive team performance and operational efficiency, ensuring smooth day-to-day execution.
* Support hiring, onboarding, and career development within the engineering function.

**Technical Oversight & Strategy**

* Oversee system architecture and technical standards, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Review and approve major technical initiatives, balancing innovation with operational stability.
* Promote engineering best practices in coding, documentation, testing, and observability.
* Contribute to high-impact technical decisions when required, providing hands-on guidance for complex problems.

**Operational Excellence**

* Monitor engineering processes, workflows, and delivery metrics to ensure consistent execution.
* Ensure cross-team alignment, knowledge sharing, and technical consistency across the organization.
* Lead initiatives for incident response, performance monitoring, and post-mortems.
* Act as a point of escalation for complex operational or technical challenges.
* Leverage AI to uncover opportunities that improve product experiences, streamline operations, and enhance team productivity.

**Key Skills**

* Deep expertise in Laravel/PHP backend systems, with experience designing scalable, maintainable, and high-performance platforms.
* Proven ability to lead and enable high-performing engineering teams, setting standards for quality and execution.
* Solid knowledge of software development best practices, including code quality, testing, documentation, and observability.
* Deep understanding of large-scale, high-performance platforms, including SQL/NoSQL, caching, and concurrency.
* Strong strategic and operational planning skills, balancing short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills (fluent English speaking and writing).
* Experience in Scrum and Agile methodology
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and containerized deployments is a plus.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* 5+ years in a leadership role, guiding teams in a high-growth environment.

* Proven experience delivering high-traffic, mission-critical platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to own technical strategy, operational processes, and team enablement.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience contributing to open-source projects or technical thought leadership is a plus.

description:
### Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced **Test Environment Manager** to lead the planning, governance, and operational management of enterprise non-production environments supporting application development, integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, and pre-production activities. This role combines **Project Management, Infrastructure Coordination, and Environment Governance** to ensure test environments are delivered on schedule, properly configured, and aligned with business and project objectives.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background in infrastructure, excellent project management skills, and proven experience coordinating cross-functional teams including Infrastructure, Network, Database, Middleware, Security, DevOps, and Application Development.

### Key Responsibilities

* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise test environments.
* Act as the primary point of contact for all environment-related activities across projects.
* Develop and maintain the enterprise Environment Roadmap and Capacity Plan.
* Lead environment planning meetings with Project Managers, Technical Leads, QA, Infrastructure, and Release Management teams.
* Coordinate environment provisioning across Server, Storage, Network, Database, Middleware, Security, and Cloud teams.
* Ensure infrastructure readiness before SIT, UAT, Performance Testing, and Pre-Production.
* Manage environment booking, allocation, scheduling, and conflict resolution across multiple concurrent projects.
* Coordinate application deployments and infrastructure changes with Release Management.
* Manage dependencies between applications, middleware, databases, network, and infrastructure services.
* Track project milestones and ensure environment delivery aligns with project timelines.
* Lead risk identification, issue management, and mitigation planning related to environment availability.
* Coordinate environment refreshes, database cloning, and test data management.
* Monitor environment utilization and optimize resource allocation.
* Lead technical discussions with infrastructure architects and engineering teams.
* Prepare executive reports, KPIs, dashboards, and environment status reports.
* Drive automation initiatives for provisioning, monitoring, and environment validation.
* Ensure compliance with Change Management, ITIL processes, and security standards.

**Requirements**

### Required Technical Skills

### Project & Service Management

* Project Management
* Environment Management
* Release Management
* Capacity Planning
* Risk Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Change Management
* ITIL Framework

### Infrastructure Knowledge

* Windows Server
* Linux
* VMware / Virtualization
* Storage & SAN
* Network Fundamentals
* Load Balancers
* DNS
* Firewalls
* SSL Certificates
* Active Directory
* Backup & Recovery

### Platforms

* OpenShift
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Cloud Platforms (AWS / Azure preferred)

### DevOps & Automation

* Azure DevOps
* Jenkins
* Git
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Infrastructure as Code (preferred)

### Database & Middleware Awareness

* Oracle
* SQL Server
* WebSphere
* MQ
* API Gateways

### Monitoring

* Dynatrace
* Splunk
* Grafana
* Prometheus

### Preferred Experience

* 8–12+ years of experience in Infrastructure, Technical Project Management, Environment Management, or Release Management.
* Minimum 5 years managing enterprise non-production environments.
* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure and distributed systems.
* Experience coordinating Infrastructure, Network, Database, Middleware, Security, and Application teams.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent enterprise projects.
* Banking or financial services experience is highly preferred.

We foster a flexible, inclusive work environment that values creativity, collaboration, and individual expression. If you’re excited about solving complex Wi-Fi networking challenges for customers and driven by customer success, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

• Act as the primary, dedicated point of contact for many of Ookla’s highest valued customers

• Actively develop and grow relationships across your customer’s business and technical organizations

• Educate, train, and support our clients to ensure optimum utilization of our product suite

• Act as the primary resolution function for any issues or questions raised by your customers

• Personally troubleshoot customer-facing business and technical issues, and drive issue escalation within Ookla as needed

• Engage with Director and C-Level executives in support of their business needs

• Partner internally with the sales team to periodically review account health and identify opportunities for future growth within your accounts, and assist with pre-sales activities

• Champion and advocate for customer requirements within Ookla (be their voice)

• Participate in customer requested meetings (onsite or via phone)

• Continually develop your own knowledge and application of new technologies to support and enable growth of our customers
